Team —

We’re at the mid-quarter checkpoint and I want a short, practical alignment so the QBR pack prep isn’t a scramble. Two asks: 1) call out any OKR scopes you think we should explicitly trim (reason + impact) and 2) nominate the dependency owners we need to pull into the QBR artifact (security, infra, procurement).

Please reply inline with: one-line scope change (if any), dependency owner name + email, and a short ETA for evidence (artifact name or link). If no change, just reply “no-scope-change”. I’m trying to keep the leadership readout to five slides, so brevity appreciated.

Relevant attachments: QBR_evidence_template_v2.pdf (template) + infra-dep-matrix.xlsx (current owners).

Timeline: replies by EOD Monday (10/12). I’ll consolidate and push to the exec deck Tuesday morning.

Thanks —
Kimberly
